name: browser.url
doc: The page the kiosk shows (default: the welcome page, http://127.0.0.1/; the self-test is http://127.0.0.1/selftest.html). A new origin also re-grants the device APIs to it.
values: an http, https, file or data URL; may contain {key} placeholders - any setting's key, e.g. {data.table} or {device.name}

name: browser.probe_url
doc: Health endpoint to probe instead of browser.url; empty probes browser.url. Needed for a file: or data: kiosk.
values: an http, https, file or data URL, or empty

name: browser.offline_url
doc: Page shown while the site is down; empty stages /data/kiosk/offline.html or the shipped page; none stays on the site.

name: browser.enforce_origin
doc: Bring the browser back when it leaves the kiosk origin. 0 for a site that hands visitors to another host.

name: browser.maintenance.enable
doc: Maintenance mode: show browser.maintenance.url instead of browser.url, which is kept as it is. `tessaro-ctl browser maintenance on|off`.

name: browser.maintenance.url
doc: The page shown in maintenance mode (default: http://127.0.0.1/maintenance.html, which takes ?title= and ?message=).
values: an http, https, file or data URL; may contain {key} placeholders - any setting's key, e.g. {data.table} or {device.name}

name: browser.debug.enable
doc: Show browser.debug.template full screen instead of the kiosk page. Not agent.debug, which is journal verbosity. `tessaro-ctl browser debug on|off`.

name: browser.debug.template
doc: What the debug screen shows: text with {key} placeholders, \n for a new line, e.g. IP {network.ip}\nGW {network.gateway}.
values: text; \n breaks a line; {key} placeholders as in browser.url, plus {browser.url}

name: browser.inject.script
doc: A script from the file store run in every page before the page's own, e.g. inject.js for /data/files/inject.js. Empty for none. `tessaro-ctl browser inject on|off`.
values: a file in the store from its root, e.g. inject.js, or empty

name: browser.bridge.mode
doc: What the page gets as window.tessaro: off, config (the settings, read-only) or actions (the settings and device actions). `tessaro-ctl browser bridge`.

name: browser.zoom
doc: Page zoom in percent, Chrome's Ctrl+/- zoom for every site, on top of screen.scale. `tessaro-ctl browser zoom`.

name: browser.args_extra
doc: Extra Chromium flags after the fixed set, e.g. --disable-pinch. Features go in browser.*_features.

name: browser.touch
doc: Touch event feature detection.

name: browser.enable_features
doc: Chromium features to enable, comma separated, e.g. WebBluetooth,WebBluetoothNewPermissionsBackend. Replaces the default: keep the AcceleratedVideoDecode* features (hardware video decode).
values: Chromium feature names, comma separated, no spaces

name: browser.disable_features
doc: Chromium features to disable. Replaces the default: keep FallbackToSWIfGLES3NotSupported (Pi 3 GPU) and PersistentHistograms (no metrics files on /data).
values: Chromium feature names, comma separated, no spaces

name: browser.fps_counter
doc: Show Chromium's FPS counter in the corner of the screen (--show-fps-counter).

name: browser.device_origins
doc: Origins granted WebSerial and WebHID besides the kiosk and self-test origins.

name: browser.block
doc: Sites the browser refuses, as Chromium URL patterns; * blocks every site not in browser.allow. The kiosk's own pages are always allowed.
values: Chromium URL patterns (example.com, [*.]example.com/menu, *), space or comma separated, or empty

name: browser.allow
doc: Exceptions to browser.block: the more specific pattern wins, and allow wins a tie. Does nothing without a block.
values: Chromium URL patterns (example.com, [*.]example.com/menu, *), space or comma separated, or empty

name: screen.scale
doc: Weston output scale: auto (2 above 3400px wide), none, or 1-4.

name: screen.resolution
doc: Output mode, WIDTHxHEIGHT from `tessaro-ctl screen modes`, or preferred. Reverts unless confirmed with `tessaro-ctl screen confirm`.
values: preferred, or WIDTHxHEIGHT from `tessaro-ctl screen modes`

name: screen.rotation
doc: How far the screen is mounted turned clockwise, for every screen: 0, 90, 180, 270, or flipped (mirrored) and flipped-90/180/270. The picture and touch turn back to stay upright. Reverts unless confirmed with `tessaro-ctl screen confirm`.
values: one of: 0, 90, 180, 270, flipped, flipped-90, flipped-180, flipped-270

name: screen.osk
doc: On-screen keyboard: auto shows it only without a USB/Bluetooth keyboard.

name: screen.input.mouse
doc: Use mice, touchpads and pen tablets; 0 ignores them, and no cursor is drawn. A touch panel that reports itself as a mouse is ignored too.

name: screen.input.keyboard
doc: Use keyboards, barcode scanners included; 0 ignores them, and screen.osk=auto shows the on-screen keyboard as if none were plugged in.

name: screen.input.touch
doc: Use touchscreens; 0 ignores them. Remote management and the VNC mirror keep working.

name: screen.vnc
doc: Mirror the screen to VNC on 127.0.0.1:5900: on to view and control it, view-only to watch only, off for no mirror.

name: audio.output
doc: Where sound plays: auto (the latest USB or Bluetooth output, else HDMI with a screen, else the jack), hdmi, jack, usb, bluetooth, off, or one output from `tessaro-ctl audio outputs`. One that is not plugged in plays on auto until it is back.
values: one of: auto, hdmi, jack, usb, bluetooth, off, or an output's name from `tessaro-ctl audio outputs`

name: audio.volume
doc: Output volume in percent, on whichever output is playing.

name: audio.mute
doc: Mute the output; audio.volume is kept for when it is unmuted.

name: audio.input
doc: Where sound is recorded from, for pages that use the microphone: auto (the latest USB or Bluetooth input, else the jack), usb, jack, bluetooth, off (the page records silence), or one input from `tessaro-ctl audio inputs`.
values: one of: auto, jack, usb, bluetooth, off, or an input's name from `tessaro-ctl audio inputs`

name: audio.input_volume
doc: Input (microphone) level in percent.

name: time.timezone
doc: The device's timezone, e.g. Europe/Bratislava, from `tessaro-ctl time zones`. Pages and the journal show local time in it; the browser follows without a restart. `tessaro-ctl time timezone`.
values: a timezone, e.g. Europe/Bratislava or UTC, from `tessaro-ctl time zones`

name: time.ntp.enable
doc: Keep the clock in sync over NTP. 0 for a network without any time server; then `tessaro-ctl time set` sets the clock by hand. `tessaro-ctl time ntp on|off`.

name: time.ntp.servers
doc: NTP servers, comma separated. Empty uses the servers the network's DHCP offers, else the image's fallback servers.
values: host names or IP addresses, comma separated, or empty

name: camera.format
doc: How cameras capture: auto (MJPEG where the camera has it, else YUYV), mjpeg or yuyv. Frames reach the page as captured, never converted. A camera without the format uses auto. `tessaro-ctl camera format`.

name: camera.size
doc: Frame size cameras capture at: auto (the largest up to 1920x1080 that keeps 25 fps), or WIDTHxHEIGHT from `tessaro-ctl camera list`. A camera without the size uses auto. `tessaro-ctl camera size`.
values: auto, or WIDTHxHEIGHT from `tessaro-ctl camera list`

name: camera.mirrors
doc: Virtual cameras each camera gets, `<camera> Mirror 1` and up, all with the same picture. Each has one reader at a time - the page, or a service on the device - so this is how many may watch a camera at once. `tessaro-ctl camera mirrors`.

name: printer.enable
doc: Let the page print: window.print() goes to the default printer without a dialog, and the page bridge's printer.print() to any printer. `tessaro-ctl printer` sets the printers up; it prints either way.

name: playlist.default
doc: The playlist the player shows when no timetable entry covers now. Set, or a timetable entry existing, puts the player on screen instead of browser.url. Empty for none. `tessaro-ctl playlist`.
values: a playlist's name from `tessaro-ctl playlist list`, or empty

name: agent.enable
doc: Supervise the browser at all; 0 parks the agent.

name: agent.debug
doc: Debug lines in the agent's journal.

name: agent.watchdog
doc: Judge the agent's pledges before pinging the systemd watchdog.

name: agent.device_access
doc: Enable CDP DeviceAccess on the page session.

name: agent.probe_interval
doc: Seconds between probes while the site is up.

name: agent.probe_interval_fail
doc: Seconds between probes while the site is down.

name: agent.probe_connect_timeout
doc: Probe connect timeout, seconds.

name: agent.probe_timeout
doc: Probe response timeout, seconds.

name: agent.fail_threshold
doc: Failed probes before the offline page.

name: agent.refresh_interval
doc: Seconds between reloads of the kiosk page; 0 never reloads. Set 0 for a manual self-test pass.

name: agent.offline_refresh
doc: Seconds between reloads of the offline page.

name: agent.ping_fails
doc: Failed browser checks before the browser is restarted.

name: agent.restart_after
doc: Failed probes while down before the browser is restarted; 0 never.

name: agent.restart_backoff
doc: Minimum seconds between browser restarts.

name: agent.cdp_timeout
doc: Budget for one DevTools command, seconds.

name: agent.cdp_ping
doc: DevTools websocket keepalive, seconds.

name: agent.cdp_reconnect_max
doc: Ceiling on the DevTools reconnect backoff, seconds.

name: device.name
doc: The device's name on the network (NAME.local, and the hotspot tessaro-NAME); empty derives one from the node id.
values: letters, digits and dashes, up to 40; empty derives one

name: device.tags
doc: Tags to find the device by and to act on a group of devices (`tessaro-ctl nodes list --tag`), announced over mDNS; `unclaimed` is reserved, every client adds it to a device nobody has claimed.
values: tags of letters, digits and dashes, comma separated, or empty

name: access.listen
doc: Where the TLS control API listens, address:port, or off.

name: access.mdns
doc: Advertise the device as NAME.local and _tessaro._tcp.

name: access.session_timeout
doc: How long a Webconfig browser session lasts without being used, seconds (default: a week). Open pages refreshing in the background do not count as use.

name: network.ethernet.interface
doc: The Ethernet port the device manages; auto is the first one that comes up. Other ports are left to hand-made profiles.
values: an interface name (eth0, enp1s0, wlan0), or auto

name: network.ethernet.mode
doc: dhcp, or static with network.ethernet.address, .gateway and .dns.

name: network.ethernet.address
doc: The static address with network.ethernet.mode=static, e.g. 192.168.1.50/24.

name: network.ethernet.gateway
doc: The default gateway with network.ethernet.mode=static; inside network.ethernet.address. Empty for none.

name: network.ethernet.dns
doc: DNS servers with network.ethernet.mode=static, comma separated.
values: IPv4 addresses, comma separated, or empty

name: network.wifi.interface
doc: The WiFi device the device manages; auto is whichever there is (wlan0, wlp1s0), so name it when there is more than one. Without one, nothing WiFi ever comes up.
values: an interface name (eth0, enp1s0, wlan0), or auto

name: network.wifi.mode
doc: hotspot (tessaro-NAME, for installation and management), client (joins network.wifi.ssid; `tessaro-ctl network wifi join`; falls back to the hotspot when it does not connect after boot, see network.wifi.fallback_after), or off.

name: network.wifi.nat
doc: Let hotspot clients reach the internet and the LAN through the device; 0 lets them reach the device only.

name: network.wifi.captive
doc: While the device is unclaimed, a phone joining the hotspot gets its sign-in sheet with Quick Setup. Quick Setup turns it off with its first saved change; Webconfig itself stays at https://10.42.0.1:7400/.

name: network.wifi.ssid
doc: The network network.wifi.mode=client joins. Its password is set by `tessaro-ctl network wifi join` and never shown.
values: a WiFi network name, 1 to 32 bytes

name: network.wifi.security
doc: The client network's security: psk (WPA2), sae (WPA3) or open. `network wifi join` finds it by scanning.

name: network.wifi.hidden
doc: The client network does not broadcast its name.

name: network.wifi.ipv4
doc: Client addressing: dhcp, or static with network.wifi.address, .gateway and .dns.

name: network.wifi.address
doc: The static client address with network.wifi.ipv4=static, e.g. 192.168.1.51/24.

name: network.wifi.gateway
doc: The default gateway with network.wifi.ipv4=static; inside network.wifi.address. Empty for none.

name: network.wifi.dns
doc: DNS servers with network.wifi.ipv4=static, comma separated.
values: IPv4 addresses, comma separated, or empty

name: network.wifi.fallback_after
doc: Seconds network.wifi.mode=client may go without connecting after boot before the device falls back to its hotspot until the next boot; 0 never.

name: network.proxy.url
doc: The proxy everything reaches the internet through: http://host:port or socks5://host:port, optionally with user:password@; empty for none. `tessaro-ctl network proxy set`.
values: http://[user:password@]host:port or socks5://[user:password@]host:port, or empty; percent-encode $ " ' \ ` @ in a password

name: network.proxy.bypass
doc: What goes around the proxy, comma separated: host names, .domain suffixes, IP addresses, networks like 192.168.0.0/16. Loopback always does.
values: host names, .domain suffixes, IP addresses or networks (10.0.0.0/8), comma separated

name: device.id
doc: The node id: systemd's app-specific machine id, never the machine id itself.
values: read-only: reported by the device, cannot be set

name: network.hostname
doc: The kernel hostname.
values: read-only: reported by the device, cannot be set

name: network.interface
doc: The interface carrying the IPv4 default route.
values: read-only: reported by the device, cannot be set

name: network.mac
doc: MAC address of network.interface.
values: read-only: reported by the device, cannot be set

name: network.ip
doc: The first IPv4 address of network.interface.
values: read-only: reported by the device, cannot be set

name: network.netmask
doc: Netmask of network.ip, dotted (255.255.255.0).
values: read-only: reported by the device, cannot be set

name: network.cidr
doc: network.ip with its prefix length (192.168.1.20/24).
values: read-only: reported by the device, cannot be set

name: network.gateway
doc: The IPv4 default gateway.
values: read-only: reported by the device, cannot be set

name: network.dns
doc: DNS servers in use, comma separated.
values: read-only: reported by the device, cannot be set

name: network.ipv4
doc: Every IPv4 address on every interface but loopback, comma separated.
values: read-only: reported by the device, cannot be set

name: network.ipv6
doc: Every IPv6 address on every interface but loopback, comma separated.
values: read-only: reported by the device, cannot be set

name: network.public_ip
doc: The address the internet sees, from Cloudflare's trace; looked up by `network show` and `config get network.public_ip`, and every 5 minutes while browser.url uses it.
values: read-only: reported by the device, cannot be set

name: network.interfaces
doc: Every interface but loopback with its state and addresses, as eth0 up 10.0.0.20/24; wlan0 down.
values: read-only: reported by the device, cannot be set

name: network.wifi.hotspot_ssid
doc: The hotspot's network name, tessaro-NAME. Open while the device is unclaimed; claiming it sets a password, shown once.
values: read-only: reported by the device, cannot be set

name: storage.size
doc: The size of the disk the device runs from, as 64.0 GB.
values: read-only: reported by the device, cannot be set

name: storage.unallocated
doc: Space after the last partition, which `storage grow` gives to /data; 0 B once it has.
values: read-only: reported by the device, cannot be set

name: storage.data_size
doc: The size of the /data filesystem.
values: read-only: reported by the device, cannot be set

name: storage.data_free
doc: Space still free on /data.
values: read-only: reported by the device, cannot be set

name: storage.data_used
doc: How full /data is, in percent (42%).
values: read-only: reported by the device, cannot be set

name: storage.root_free
doc: Space free on the root filesystem, which is read-only and changes only with an update.
values: read-only: reported by the device, cannot be set

name: data.<name>
doc: Custom values with names you choose, for browser.url: data.table=12 fills {data.table}, as in https://menu.test/?table={data.table}. The kiosk gives them no meaning of its own. Set them before or together with a browser.url that uses them. A placeholder is always a full key, so built-in settings work the same way: {device.name}, {screen.scale}, ... No custom values are defined on this device yet.
values: any text; percent-encoded where browser.url uses it
